knowledge:
- key_parameters: Method=Specifies the Stan inference engine to use (e.g., "sampling" for MCMC/NUTS, or ADVI/BFGS) ;; ReturnBASiCS=Logical indicating whether to return a BASiCS_Chain object (TRUE) or a raw Stan object (FALSE) ;; iter=Number of iterations for the Stan sampler ;; Regression=Must be set to TRUE as the joint regression prior is the only supported mode in BASiCStan
- alternatives: BASiCS::BASiCS_MCMC=Uses adaptive Metropolis within Gibbs sampling; prefer BASiCStan when alternative inference engines (like ADVI or NUTS) or Stan's diagnostic tools are needed
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing single-cell RNA-seq count data to estimate gene-specific expression mean and over-dispersion parameters, particularly when standard MCMC is too slow or when detailed Stan diagnostics are required
- pitfalls: Regression = TRUE is the only supported mode in BASiCStan() ;; Low iteration counts (e.g., iter = 10) or small warmup sizes will trigger warnings about lack of variance estimation and divergent transitions ;; The normalizeCounts function is deprecated and users should use scrapper::normalizeCounts instead

workflows.name: basics_stan_inference
workflows.intent: Perform parameter estimation for single-cell RNA-seq data using Stan-based inference and convert the output for downstream BASiCS analysis.
input: sce (SingleCellExperiment object containing single-cell expression counts and spike-in information)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the package and generate or load the SingleCellExperiment dataset ;; 2. Run parameter estimation using BASiCStan to obtain a BASiCS_Chain object ;; 3. Run BASiCStan with ReturnBASiCS = FALSE to obtain a raw Stan object for diagnostics ;; 4. Convert the raw Stan object to a BASiCS_Chain object using Stan2BASiCS
workflows.code:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library("BASiCStan"))
set.seed(42)
sce <- BASiCS_MockSCE()
stan_fit <- BASiCStan(sce, Method = "sampling", iter = 10)
BASiCS_ShowFit(stan_fit)
stan_obj <- BASiCStan(sce, ReturnBASiCS = FALSE, Method = "sampling", iter = 10)
head(summary(stan_obj)$summary)
Stan2BASiCS(stan_obj)
